bills.title: Bills and payments
bills.subtitle: Supplier bills with GST worked out by the server, what is owed, and payments set against bills.
bills.readOnly: Read-only view: payments are made by accounts.
bills.noPayRight: You can see payments but not make them. Ask Admin for the receipts and payments right.
bills.noBillRight: You can see supplier bills but not enter them. Ask Admin for the purchase bills right.

err.gstin: This company has no GSTIN yet. Admin adds it on Branches and GSTINs.
err.line: Line {{n}} needs an item or account, a quantity above zero and a valid rate (an account line also needs a description).

editor.title: New supplier bill
editor.noSuppliers: No suppliers yet — add them on Suppliers
editor.itc: Input tax credit can be claimed
editor.keyboard: Enter on the last rate adds a line. Tax comes from the HSN rate on the bill date; the server works it out.
editor.posted: Supplier bill {{no}} posted to the books.
editor.confirmEffect: Posts bill {{no}} from {{supplier}} for ₹{{total}} to the books: purchase and input GST debited, the supplier credited. A posted bill is never edited; a mistake is reversed.

list.title: Supplier bills
list.emptyBody: Enter the first bill above; it appears here as a draft until posted.

payables.title: Open supplier bills
payables.msmeSub: Micro and small suppliers are paid within the agreed period, at most 45 days.
payables.emptyBody: Posted supplier bills and opening bills from Tally appear here until they are paid.

pay.title: New payment
pay.noAccount: No account yet — Admin adds it on Bank → Set-up
pay.chooseFirst: Choose the supplier to see their open bills.
pay.noOpenTitle: No open bills for this supplier
pay.noOpenBody: The whole payment stays on account as an advance.
pay.overLimitTitle: Over the daily cash limit to one person.
pay.overLimitBody: Cash paid over the limit to one person in a day can't be claimed as an expense. Pay by bank instead, or give the reason and pay in cash; Admin sees it.
pay.reason: Why it must be cash (Admin sees this)
pay.payCashAnyway: Pay in cash with this reason
pay.flagged: Flagged for Admin: cash over the daily limit.

err.noCash: No cash account yet. Admin adds it on Bank → Set-up.
err.noBank: No bank account yet. Admin adds it on Bank → Set-up.
err.amount: Type an amount above zero, like 1500 or 1500.50.
err.allocFormat: Type each bill amount like 1500 or 1500.50.
err.allocOver: The bills add up to more than the payment.
err.reason: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.

paylist.title: Payments
paylist.reverseEffect: Posts a reversal of ₹{{amount}} linked to the original; the bills it paid are open again. The original is never edited.
paylist.emptyBody: Payments posted here or on the cash book appear in this list.
